visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A high-definition, eye-level close-up shows a tabby cat with brown and black stripes sleeping soundly on its side in a light grey, circular pet bed. A white "Z" graphic floats near its head. A fair-skinned human hand enters from the right, extending its fingers toward the cat's long whiskers. (2) The hand begins to pluck the cat's whiskers rhythmically. The cat is completely immobile, with its eyes closed and front paw curled in. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows within the room. A text overlay in the upper third of the frame provides contextual commentary. (3) The scene transitions to a static branding screen with a white background. At the center is a simplified cartoon cat face wearing a yellow headband with the characters "榮師傅" above and "Master Rong" below. A line of smaller text appears at the bottom of the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio sequence opens with a highly prominent, rhythmic snoring sound. It possesses a wet, percussive quality with a wide spectral bandwidth, sounding strikingly like a large animal or a human in a very deep slumber. The background noise floor is minimal, emphasizing the snoring's texture. (2) A lighthearted, bouncy background music track featuring an acoustic guitar enters the mix. The guitar has a bright, clean tone and plays a simple melody in a major key at approximately 110 BPM. The snoring sound persists as a rhythmic counterpoint to the music, creating a humorous juxtaposition. (3) The music concludes with a short, final harmonic flourish. Immediately following, a distinct, stylized cat "meow" sound effect is triggered, serving as a playful audio punctuation. The overall mix is well-balanced, with the music and sound effects clearly separated and lacking any technical distortion.

By pairing the visual of 'playing' the cat's whiskers with a comical snoring soundtrack and bouncy acoustic music, it creates a relatable and funny moment for pet owners, ultimately serving as a creative branding clip for a guitar teacher or content creator.
